field_descriptions.antagonist: The muscle whose action counteracts the specified muscle.
field_descriptions.blood_supply: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.insertion: The place of attachment of a muscle, or what the muscle moves.
field_descriptions.nerve: The underlying innervation associated with the muscle.
